responsibility: Provides the Linux/ELF subtarget configuration overrides for the M32R port. This header adjusts ABI-facing C type definitions, selects the correct dynamic linker and emulation name for big- vs. little-endian Linux, and defines the driver specs that control linking, startup/end files, libc/pthread selection, PIE/shared/static handling, Linux-specific preprocessor builtins, and end-of-file exec-stack marking, thereby specializing the generic M32R target configuration for GNU/Linux system integration.
